speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
text: Is advertising deployed primarily where there is a need or there is seen to be a need to encourage citizens, the target of the advertising, to take certain action or to do something?

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
text: Is that the main consideration or is it also just general awareness, view or disposition towards the policy or measure that is being advertised?
